findings.issue: BA draft called is_codex_thread_id then find_codex_rollout separately — double find cost
findings.proposed_fix: Call find_codex_rollout once, validate inline with _validate_codex_rollout >/dev/null 2>&1
findings.rationale: Codex PROPOSED_FIX is more efficient and avoids redundant filesystem scans

findings.issue: Using echo '{...}' with unescaped shell variables for JSON construction — injection risk if paths contain special chars
findings.proposed_fix: Use jq -n --arg id --arg flavor --arg wd --arg home --arg sf --argjson exists --argjson size
findings.rationale: jq --arg handles escaping; paths with quotes/backslashes are safe

findings.issue: 4th flavor field in raw_sessions format would require updating all callers of scan_running_sessions
findings.proposed_fix: Classify inside write_json_snapshot only — call find_codex_rollout per entry
findings.rationale: Minimal scope: change only write_json_snapshot, not the upstream data format

findings.issue: claude_id rename would break 5 jq consumers
findings.proposed_fix: Do NOT rename — keep claude_id, add separate flavor field
findings.rationale: Minimal scope; renaming is a separate breaking change not requested by user
